description: This file defines a `ValidationService` class providing functionality for executing validation runs, generating validation reports, and interacting with the database and filesystem for validation artifacts. It includes methods for running validations, retrieving reports, and listing validation runs, as well as internal checks for schema conformance, freshness, and completeness.

classes.name: ValidationService
classes.description: Service for validation run execution and report generation.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] run_validation( self, submission_id: str, validation_profile: str = "baseline", actor_user_id: str = "system", actor_role: str = "system", correlation_id: str = "", )
methods.description: Executes a validation run for a submission, generates a report, stores artifacts, and updates the database.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _check_schema_conformance(self, package: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Performs a schema conformance check on the provided package.

methods.description: Performs a freshness check on the provided package.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _check_completeness(self, package: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Performs a completeness check on the provided package.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_validation_report(self, validation_run_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a validation report by validation run ID, loading it from storage if available.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_validation_runs(self, submission_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all validation runs associated with a submission, ordered by creation time.
